prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: transparent pair of small hands to place on the top edge of a class group photograph in an A4 printed yearbook. Primary request: Two photorealistic youthful fair-skinned hands belonging to the same teenage boy, peeking over and gently gripping the top of an invisible rectangular photo card, as if a person is hiding behind it. Front-facing camera, soft neutral outdoor daylight, natural skin texture, restrained realistic tones, no dramatic shadow. The backs/knuckles and four gently curled fingertips of each hand are visible facing the viewer; thumbs are hidden behind the invisible card. No arms or wrists extending below, just small hand fragments gripping one common horizontal edge. Each hand must have plausible anatomy and correct finger count. Composition: the two hands sit on the exact same horizontal baseline, one centered at 20% of the canvas width and the other at 80%, with a large completely transparent gap between them. Compact equal-size hands, overall composition much wider than tall. The entire background and the area between and under the hands must be genuinely transparent. No visible card or paper, no text, no head, no face, no torso, no extra limbs. These will be layered as very small realistic photo cutouts; avoid illustration, cartoon, colored outlines, exaggerated fingers or gesture.
use: Small cover grip; original portrait remains unchanged.
